$comment: Accepted HIGH/CRITICAL production advisories (phase 11 M3). Each entry needs a GHSA id, the package, a justification, a severity, and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) that is at most 7 days (critical) or 30 days (high) after addedAt (ADR-028); an expired entry blocks again (in diff mode only when the change introduces the finding; the nightly scan always). Checked by apps/api/scripts/security/audit-gate.ts. "imageExceptions" are the accepted Trivy findings of the Docker images (OS packages, and the library findings of the nightly scan): each has a CVE id, severity, reason and expiry under the same limits, and must match .trivyignore exactly (apps/api/test/unit/image-exceptions.test.ts). Both lists are empty today (2026-11-01): every advisory was fixed by updating the dependency.
